summary.headline: Planetary Temperaments and Hour Lords
summary.text: Discussion of planetary temperaments, gender, diurnal and nocturnal qualities, including Mercury’s dependence on its associations and eastern or western elongation. The text then explains planetary rulers of the 168 unequal hours of a week, beginning Sunday with the Sun and proceeding through Venus, Mercury, and the remaining planets.
